картина: Release note официального фида Google Workspace Updates от 20.11.2025 для админов и пользователей Workspace: запуск Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) в Slides, Vids, Gemini app и NotebookLM. Разобраны поверхности: Slides (Help me visualize — инфографика с опорой на Google Search, Images, Beautify this slide с более точным текстом), NotebookLM (инфографика и деки из источников), Vids (multi-turn доработка), Gemini app (Create images + Thinking). Важная для правил часть — Note: промо-лимиты минимум 60 дней, затем per-user лимиты, генерация/редактирование только 18+, доступ на Vertex AI. Далее — раскатка, тарифы, ссылки для админов. Промптов-примеров нет.
структура: Google Slides (Infographic / Images / Beautify this slide)

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro is Gemini 3 Pro Image, described as Google's new state-of-the-art image generation and editing model.
единицы.цитата: We’re excited to introduce Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image), our new state-of-the-art image generation and editing model.

единицы.утверждение_en: Starting 2025-11-20, Nano Banana Pro rolled out to Google Workspace customers in Google Slides, Vids, the Gemini app and NotebookLM.
единицы.цитата: Starting today, Nano Banana Pro is rolling out to Google Workspace customers in Google Slides, Vids, the Gemini app, and NotebookLM.

единицы.утверждение_en: In Slides, 'Help me visualize' now uses Nano Banana Pro to create infographics, images and slides.
единицы.цитата: “Help me visualize” in Slides now uses Nano Banana Pro to help anyone create stunning infographics, images, and slides.

единицы.утверждение_en: 'Beautify this slide' is a new Slides experience that creates designed visuals based on the content of an existing slide, usable as individual slides.
единицы.цитата: We also added an all-new experience, “Beautify this slide”, to help people create thoughtfully designed visuals—based on the content of an existing slide—that can be used as individual slides.
единицы.заметка: Вход — содержимое существующего слайда, а не отдельный промпт.

единицы.утверждение_en: Slides can generate detailed, professional infographics from just a simple prompt.
единицы.цитата: Generate detailed, professional infographics directly in Slides, all with just a simple prompt.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro is connected to Google Search's knowledge base, so it represents real-world objects and places well while also taking into account the details described in the prompt.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana Pro is connected to Google Search’s vast knowledge base, meaning it does an incredible job at representing real-world objects and places, all while taking into account the details you describe in your prompt.
единицы.заметка: Сказано в подразделе Infographic (Slides); распространяется ли связь с Search на другие поверхности, прямо не сказано.

единицы.утверждение_en: Image creation in Slides keeps the same experience but now uses Nano Banana Pro to create realistic images for slide decks.
единицы.цитата: The same experience you know, now using Nano Banana Pro. Create stunning, realistic images that help add value to any slide deck.

единицы.утверждение_en: 'Beautify this slide' turns ideas into a visual with more accurate, legible text in one click, while modeling the look and feel of the overall deck.
единицы.цитата: In just a click, “Beautify this slide” turns your ideas into a compelling visual with more accurate, legible text while modeling the look and feel of the overall deck.

единицы.утверждение_en: To add a 'Beautify this slide' result to the deck, select 'insert as new slide' and it is added as an individual slide.
единицы.цитата: Simply select “insert as new slide” and the visual will be added directly into your deck as an individual slide.

единицы.утверждение_en: In NotebookLM, Nano Banana Pro visualizes key insights from the user's sources as high-quality infographics that distill complex information and relationships into a single visual.
единицы.цитата: With Nano Banana Pro in NotebookLM, you can now visualize key insights from your sources as high-quality infographics. This allows you to distill complex information and relationships into a single, high-impact visual that makes your data easier to digest.
единицы.заметка: Источник содержания — загруженные в NotebookLM источники.

единицы.утверждение_en: In NotebookLM users can also create complete slide decks directly from their sources and share them as a PDF.
единицы.цитата: You can also create complete and polished slide decks directly from your sources and share them as a PDF.

единицы.утверждение_en: In Google Vids, Nano Banana Pro generates and edits images with greater precision, and new multi-turn prompting lets users refine visuals iteratively into production-ready assets.
единицы.цитата: In Google Vids, Nano Banana Pro allows you to generate and edit images with greater precision. With new multi-turn prompting, you can refine your visuals iteratively, helping you create custom, production-ready assets to include in your videos.
единицы.заметка: Итеративная доработка через несколько ходов диалога.

единицы.утверждение_en: In the Gemini app, access Nano Banana Pro by selecting 'Create images' and 'Thinking' from the model drop-down menu.
единицы.цитата: Simply select “Create images” and “Thinking” from the model drop down menu to access Nano Banana Pro.
единицы.заметка: Nano Banana Pro в Gemini app — через режим 'Thinking' (на дату записи).

единицы.утверждение_en: Workspace customers get promotional access to higher Nano Banana Pro usage limits in these apps for at least 60 days; per-user usage limits apply afterward, with advance notice promised before changes.
единицы.цитата: Workspace customers will get promotional access to higher usage limits of Nano Banana Pro in these apps for at least 60 days, allowing users to experiment with these features. Per-user usage limits will apply afterward; we’ll provide more information in a future update prior to any changes.

единицы.утверждение_en: At the time of the post, image generation and editing is only available to users over the age of 18.
единицы.цитата: At this time, image generation and editing is only available to users over the age of 18.
единицы.заметка: 'At this time' — состояние на 2025-11-20; фраза сформулирована общо (генерация и редактирование картинок), не только для NB Pro.

единицы.утверждение_en: Developers and business teams can also access Nano Banana Pro on Vertex AI, and soon in Gemini Enterprise.
единицы.цитата: Developers and business teams can also access Nano Banana Pro on Vertex AI, and soon in Gemini Enterprise.

единицы.утверждение_en: There are no admin controls for this feature.
единицы.цитата: There are no admin controls for this feature.
единицы.заметка: См. длинную дистанцию: в Resources есть включение/выключение самих приложений.

единицы.утверждение_en: Rollout for Rapid Release and Scheduled Release domains is gradual, up to 15 days for feature visibility, starting November 20, 2025.
единицы.цитата: : Gradual rollout (up to 15 days for feature visibility) starting on November 20, 2025
единицы.заметка: Строки 112-113: 'Rapid Release and Scheduled Release domains / : Gradual rollout…'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro in Slides, Vids, the Gemini app and NotebookLM is available for Workspace Business Standard and Plus, Enterprise Standard and Plus, Google AI Pro and AI Ultra, Google AI Ultra for Business, and Google AI Pro for Education.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana Pro in Google Slides, Google Vids, the Gemini app, and NotebookLM is available for:

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro in the Gemini app and NotebookLM is additionally available for Workspace Essentials Starter/Enterprise Essentials/Plus, Business Starter, Enterprise Starter, Nonprofits, Education Fundamentals/Standard/Plus and Frontline Starter/Standard/Plus.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana Pro in the Gemini app and NotebookLM is also available for Google Workspace:

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro in Vids is additionally available for Essentials editions, and (marked *) for Business Starter, Enterprise Starter, Nonprofits and Education Plus / Teaching and Learning add-on, which can access generative AI features in Vids for a limited time, at least through May 31, 2026.
единицы.цитата: *For a limited time, at least through May 31, 2026, these plans can access generative AI features in Vids.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Admin control is only at the app or Gemini-feature level: the post says there are no admin controls for Nano Banana Pro itself, while its Resources point to toggles for turning the Gemini app, NotebookLM and Vids on or off and managing access to Gemini features.
длинная_дистанция.как_получено: выведено из E-237-17 и списка Resources (строки 138-145)

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Across surfaces, Nano Banana Pro is not a separate app but replaces or powers existing entry points: 'Help me visualize' and Images in Slides, infographics and decks in NotebookLM, multi-turn image editing in Vids, and the 'Create images' + 'Thinking' choice in the Gemini app.
The post's stated differentiators for Nano Banana Pro in Workspace are grounding in Google Search knowledge for real-world objects and places, and more accurate, legible text.

не_сказано: Нет числовых лимитов ни на промо-период, ни после него.
Связь с Google Search названа только в подразделе Infographic (Slides); для Vids, NotebookLM, Gemini app — не сказано.
Нет разрешений, соотношений сторон, числа референсов, примеров промптов.
Не уточнено, как проверяется возраст 18+ и распространяется ли ограничение на все поверхности.
сомнения: По пометке партии, сильно пересекается с блог-постом id 230 о том же запуске.
Ограничение 18+ сформулировано 'At this time' — позднее могло измениться (в этой партии есть id 238 от декабря 2025 о доступе всех возрастов; здесь не сопоставлялось).
